name: Russian
modelReview: Russian as written in Ukraine (the maintainer's ruling, 2026-11-19). Usage notes written in Russian that day by a writer briefed as an editor living in Ukraine, told nothing of cron, who found no difference in the language of schedules between Ukraine and the Russian Federation (carriers' own Russian texts could not be found; several reference works are cited from memory). Answers, lexicon and hand-written rows by Claude Fable 5.2 the same day, without reading the Ukrainian artifacts: three author passes against one adversarial schedule read of all 634 rows and two blind readers briefed as editors in Ukraine, asked for every reading of each sentence. Renderer built by an agent that saw no other renderer and no held-out row: 152 of 153 held-out rows on the first judged run (the miss and two hard cases settled against the rows). Audited by an independent agent: two wrong schedules repaired test-first (29 February said as yearly; a fifth weekday said without its condition) and several unholdable forms. Not read by anyone independent: the 124 forms of the last author pass and the 46 the audit changed. Thin evidence: «в чётные часы» (two blind readers, no corpus source; Russian's ordinal count of hours is a known risk); ordinal minutes; «по будням» (usage notes and three Ukrainian Russian-language pages). Known heavy forms: eight or nine windows for minutes under scattered hours. Taste calls by the orchestrating model (Claude Fable 5.2) are recorded in the answers with their evidence
